description: IFRS/HKFRS measurement engine. Compute goodwill and purchase-price allocation, impairment (IAS 36), inventory net realisable value, held-for-sale, debt waterfalls, cap tables, sum-of-the-parts and SPAC redemption; residual income and justified price-to-book; and non-financial asset fair value: investment property (IAS 40 / HKAS 40), PP&E revaluation via depreciated replacement cost (IAS 16) and biological assets at fair value less costs to sell (IAS 41). Use this for accounting-basis measurement of assets and equity; for going-concern cash flow use calculate_dcf and for peer multiples use calculate_market_multiple. Methods: goodwill: purchase_price, fair_value_net_identifiable_assets; ppa: purchase_price, tangible_assets_fv, identified_intangibles_fv; impairment_fvlcd: carrying_value, fair_value_less_costs_to_dispose; impairment_viu: carrying_value, value_in_use; inventory_nrv: carrying_value, net_realisable_value; held_for_sale: carrying_value, fair_value_less_costs_to_sell; debt_waterfall/cap_table: enterprise_value, claims; sotp: segments, net_debt, holding_discount; spac_redemption: trust_cash, shares_outstanding, redemption_price; investment_property: noi, cap_rate; ppe_revaluation: replacement_cost, accumulated_depreciation; biological_asset: expected_price, quantity, costs_to_sell; residual_income: book_value, net_income, cost_equity; justified_pb: roe, cost_equity, growth_rate; relief_from_royalty: revenue, royalty_rate, discount_rate, periods; mpeem: cash_flows, contributory_charges, discount_rate; with_without: with_cash_flows, without_cash_flows, discount_rate; recoverable_amount: fair_value_less_costs_to_dispose, value_in_use; liability_fulfilment: fulfilment_costs, mark_up, discount_rate; inventory_residual: selling_price, costs_to_complete, profit_allowance; development_residual: gross_development_value, development_costs, developer_profit. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

book_value.description: Book value of equity in reporting currency.

cash_flows.description: Projected cash flows in reporting currency, indexed t=1..n.

claims.description: Ordered claims [{name, amount, priority}] for a waterfall.

contributory_charges.description: Contributory-asset charges (economic rent) per period, aligned with cash_flows (IVS 210 MPEEM).

cost_equity.description: Cost of equity as a decimal (0.12 = 12%).

costs_to_complete.description: Remaining costs to complete work-in-process inventory (IVS 230).

development_costs.description: All known/anticipated costs to complete the development.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%); pre-tax when method=viu_pre_tax.

expected_price.description: Expected market price per biological-asset unit (IAS 41).

fair_value_less_costs_to_sell.description: FV less costs to sell in reporting currency.

fair_value_net_identifiable_assets.description: Fair value of net identifiable assets.

fulfilment_costs.description: Costs required to fulfil the performance obligation per period (IVS 220 Bottom-Up).

gross_development_value.description: Anticipated value of the completed development (IVS 410 residual method).

growth_rate.description: Periodic growth rate as a decimal (0.03 = 3%).

identified_intangibles_fv.description: Fair value of separately identified intangibles.

mark_up.description: Reasonable mark-up on fulfilment costs (decimal, IVS 220 Bottom-Up).

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

net_debt.description: Total debt minus cash and equivalents.

noi.description: Net operating income of the property (IAS 40).

profit_allowance.description: Estimated profit allowance on the completion/disposal effort.

royalty_rate.description: Royalty rate as a decimal (0.05 = 5% of revenue).

selling_price.description: Estimated selling price of the finished inventory (IVS 230 top-down).

trust_cash.description: SPAC trust cash available for redemption.

value_in_use.description: Value in use in reporting currency.

with_cash_flows.description: After-tax cash flows with the asset in use (IVS 210 with-and-without).

without_cash_flows.description: After-tax cash flows absent the asset (IVS 210 with-and-without), aligned with with_cash_flows.

name: calculate_residual

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: IFRS measurement, residual income and non-financial fair value
